* * *

## [I ordered four custom hand towels for…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a6e13616af862bb5b482b2a)
I ordered four custom hand towels for the restrooms in my business. I ordered from you because I felt like the quality and design would be on point. Towels arrived, and all of them were cut crooked. So they aren’t squares they are misshapen. They don’t fold or hang straight. The binding on the edges is already coming undone. After one wash loops in the cotton were also coming out. And customer service, slow to respond, offered me a $28 credit for it. Which is honestly a slap in the face considering how much I spent on four custom hand towels. I am still waiting several days later on a reply. This is not what I expected from my purchase with you.

July 20, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 4, 2026

Hi there,

We're sorry to hear about this. We can see that one of our Customer Experience Specialists is actively working on your case and will provide you with an update as soon as more information becomes available.

We appreciate your patience in the meantime!
